capabilities: Build a letter from note frontmatter and body
Export letter to PDF on desktop and mobile
Print letter via the system print dialog
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown-to-PDF converter; it only formats letters from frontmatter fields in DIN 5008 or modern layouts.
extras: Runs locally with no telemetry; only network use is loading https images embedded in the letter body at export. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+. AGPL-3.0, no runtime dependencies. Full documentation hosted outside the README (docs/reference/settings.md, theming, troubleshooting).
problem: Obsidian has no way to produce properly formatted business letters with correct address geometry for window envelopes from a note.
summary: Plugin that turns a note with letter fields in frontmatter into a formatted DIN 5008 or modern business letter and exports it as PDF.
